services.name: Book a Sail
services.desc: Timed for the last light of the day. Your group, your skipper, no strangers on board. Your sail is timed for the last light of the day. As the mountains turn gold and the skyline begins to glow, the pace slows down and the city feels entirely different from the water. Evening slots fill quickly in peak season. Weekend dates typically book 2 to 3 weeks out. Wingaway is a 40 foot Beneteau Oceanis designed for comfortable evenings on the water, with wide decks, cushioned cockpit seating, and plenty of space to move around

services.name: Private charter
services.desc: Pick your date, pick your departure time. Up to 9 guests, flat rate per booking. No strangers, no fixed agenda. Wingaway is a 40ft Beneteau Oceanis designed for comfortable coastal sailing. Wide decks, cushioned cockpit seating, and plenty of space to move around underway. Stable enough that first-timers feel at ease within minutes. Vancouver by Sea is located on the traditional, ancestral and unceded territory of the sḵwṳᵉṱ wúʔ7mesh (Squamish), selíļwítuth (Tsleil-Waututh) and xʷməθkʷə̇ əm (Musqueam)

services.name: Harbour & Wildlife Sail
services.desc: A daytime sail past Stanley Park, Siwash Rock, and the quiet bays where wildlife gathers. The whole yacht is yours for three hours. Three hours along one of the most scenic stretches of urban coastline in the world. Your skipper reads the conditions and picks the route. You just enjoy what comes into view. Wingaway is a 40 foot Beneteau Oceanis with wide decks, cushioned cockpit seating, and plenty of room to move around. Comfortable for groups, easy to sail, and well suited to Vancouver's harbour. Maren grew up racing dinghies, lived aboard for stretches, and once sailed his family to Mexico. A trip that confirmed sailing was not just a hobby but a personality
